verdict_reason: All 5 SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE cases have verified co-occurrence of (device, mechanism) in real patent text, with deterministic spans, offsets, and dual-model classification agreement. No TYPE C or D cases among positives.

construction_method.mining: Streaming patents from HuggingFace allenai/us-patents, regex co-occurrence within 1500-char window
construction_method.span_extraction: Deterministic from regex matches + sentence boundaries + functional language detection
construction_method.classification: Dual-model: primary (deepseek-v4-flash) + secondary (llama-3.3-70b). VERIFIED requires both to agree A/B.
construction_method.negatives: Preserved from V1 oracle (patents where device/mechanism don't co-occur)
construction_method.contradictory: Constructed from real patent-vs-science conflicts (NEJM, Lancet, IOVS citations)
